item.text: The records distinguish document-list status from verified meeting decisions. I’m using dispositions marked `source_verified` with assessment scope `whole_target`, and joining each decision event to its meeting. Four named documents have no explicit CR-pack membership; I’ll return empty rows for those unless another permitted record supplies that link.

item.text: I found one reading that changes the result: “modify clause 12” can include changes to its subclauses, or only links to clause 12 itself. I’m using the inclusive reading and recording the exact-clause alternative in the note. The revision questions each lead to one qualifying later document under either reading of “final.”

I treated JSON-LD identifiers as join keys. Qualifying dispositions required `source_verified` evidence and assessment scope `whole_target`; their decision events supplied the RAN4 meeting. Revision links identified later documents, `targetRelease` identified CR releases, and pack membership supplied plenary meetings. Clause relations and raw affected-clause metadata identified modifications. For explicitly named documents, I did not substitute another revision when pack membership was absent.
